title: This is an excellent spoon rest in EVERY WAY but ONE; the pesky label took me over 2 hrs to remove
text:
This is an excellent spoon rest in EVERY WAY but ONE; the pesky label took me over 2 hrs to remove. This spoon rest is sturdy, has a non-skid surface that keeps it from sliding on the counter (photo 2), and holds many items. The third picture shows it holding two tea infuser baskets which is great for when I want to not drain the steeped tea leaf water on my counter. The fourth photo shows it holding an almost 3-inch spatula. The last photo shows a 4-inch one. This cannot successfully accommodate anything wider than 3.75 inches.

The one bothersome point that had me removing not one but two stars was the label that was affixed to the entire top surface of the tray. I tried lightly removing it with a razor. Then I tried to lift the corners with the tip of a knife. I had to be careful because I did not want to scratch the surface. I do not have any long fingernails, so I could not try that. I then had to soak it for a FULL TWO HOURS in Dawn Platinum dish detergent before I could even try to use my fingernail nubs to just barely lift one edge. Even when I did that, I had trouble pulling up the label because, it is so strongly affixed to the spoon rest. I had to use all my strength in my hands to finally remove the label. Total time it took was TWO and a HALF HOURS. The only positive is that it was a clean pull with no adhesive left behind.

A label that does not easily remove from a product is a deal breaker for me even if it is not for others. Therefore, this gets 3 stars for that reason. The product itself, once the label is removed, is 5 stars.
